# Angle performance (closed-loop learning)

Rolling tally of signal -> outreach angle -> channel -> response -> outcome. Updated by every engine sweep from responses.md and the follow-up log. Optimize toward qualified conversation -> meeting -> customer -> revenue, never toward opens, clicks, or follows.

## How to log
Each round appends one row per outreach batch sent (initials, F1, F2, review-triggered). Outcome is filled when known: no_response, reply_positive, reply_neutral, reply_negative, meeting, customer.

## Copy-test protocol (round 44, targets the response bottleneck)
OBSERVED: ~50 campaign sends, 0 positive replies, 1 decline (Roaring Fork Landscapes, 2026-09-10). The revenue chain stalls at outreach_sent -> responses, not at research or send mechanics. Next cold-draft batch runs as a 2-variant test: variant A = current tailored angle; variant B = one specific verified observation + one question, no pitch paragraph. Split the batch evenly, log the variant in the row's Angle field as "[A]" / "[B]", keep the cap and ladders unchanged. Success = first directional read on message-market fit (any genuine reply breaks the 0% baseline); the winning variant becomes the new A. Reversible (draft text only), bounded (one batch, in-cap), authority-neutral (no infra, no verification change).
